newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-BARCELONA CLOSE TO SIGNING ANDERSON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA CLOSE TO SIGNING ANDERSON.

text.p: Brazil's Sonny Anderson is set to leave Monaco to join Barcelona for five seasons in a deal estimated at 120 million francs ($20 million), club sources said.
A Barcelona deputation headed by vice-president Joan Gaspart arrived in the principality on Wednesday to negotiate the transfer with Monaco president Jean-Louis Campora.

The striker, who has just been called into the Brazilian squad by coach Mario Zagallo for a Far East tour, missed a friendly between Monaco and Nice on Wednesday and was absent from club training on Thursday morning.
"There's little doubt that Anderson will play for Barcelona next season," said Monaco assistant coach Jean Petit.

Anderson, France's leading goalscorer in the 1995-96 season, joined Monaco in 1994 from Marseille. He left Brazil in 1992 to join Servette Geneva, who should receive up to 45 percent of the profit made from an Anderson move to Barcelona.
A definite decision was expected later on Thursday.
